tip: Bli plus a past participle is a second passive. Blev stulen stresses a single completed event, unlike the -s passive.
In a passive, av names the doer, like English by. Godkändes av chefen means approved by the boss.
Liknas takes vid, not av, for the thing compared to. Hon liknas vid sin mamma = she is likened to her mother.
Turas om means take turns. It is a set phrase: turas om att laga mat = take turns cooking.
For a hypothetical, use past tense after om and skulle in the result: om vi hade pengar skulle vi resa.
Skulle vilja is the polite would like, softer than vill (want). Jag skulle vilja ha en kaffe.
